correctness.rationale: A direct elementary-collapse proof covers all finite triangle-free graphs with pairwise edge-disjoint squares. The dual complex contains complete one-skeleton, one induced two-path triangle per connected triple, and one tetrahedron per square. Each nonsquare triangle has a unique free long edge; each square removes one tetrahedron and three more triangles by local collapses, with no interference thanks to edge-disjointness. The resulting connected graph has the stated first Betti number. Alexander duality yields integral homology concentrated in degree n-4; a full two-skeleton for n>=8 gives simple connectivity and Hurewicz-Whitehead upgrades the integral homology statement to the claimed homotopy wedge. Four complete finite mod-two reconstructions match the formula; finite checks are not treated as the general proof.

originality.rationale: The original cut-complex paper classifies forests, cycles, complete multipartite graphs, and particular graph operations, but not the full class of triangle-free graphs with edge-disjoint four-cycles. Its complete codimension-one skeleton hypothesis is false here because each square yields a missing face. The square-free case is a strict special case, not a covering statement. A constructive collapse proves an exact additive correction for every allowed square. No exact equivalent or stronger published theorem was found in targeted searches; possible uncatalogued hypergraph formulations remain a genuine risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed preprints, theses or hypergraph formulations might contain an equivalent square-packing result.

value.rationale: This treats a broad natural graph class at the exact girth-four boundary of the square-free classification. Any number of non-overlapping squares is allowed, including configurations where they share vertices and where the rest of the graph has arbitrary longer cycles; the theorem identifies the exact additive correction per square and derives an entire homotopy type rather than a numerical experiment. The disjointness condition has a structural role, ensuring a global sequence of elementary collapses, and overlapping squares require new methods.
